GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay then tightened & checked, Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to Turn then Hooked Out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , Dropped Out in Straight # wide/weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at start and shortly after, checked when tightened.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide racing ungenerously, Moved Up to 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked wider Straightening Up and made up a couple of Lengths in straight. [Stewards: Raced ungenerously early stages. Hung out leaving the 800m. App. jockey reported it raced ungenerously throughout, proving difficult to ride. Warning placed on its racing manners.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped. Laid in shortly after the start. Raced ungenerously early and leaving the 800m, hung out. Rdr reported mount raced ungenerously throughout, proving difficult to ride. Warning for racing manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then steadied off heels and Settled Down last of seven runners trailing 8 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 6.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn then Made Some Ground in Straight # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied from heels shortly after the start. Shifted in shortly thereafter and became awkwardly placed on heels for a number of strides. Held up approaching the home turn. Obliged to alter course near the 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early stages. Passing the 1000m, when racing keenly, had to be eased when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 1 length 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: App. jockey reported it was inclined to lay in throughout.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Shortly after the start whilst laying in, became awkwardly placed close to heels, then clipped heels and blundered. Approaching the turn near the 800m, commenced to over race and shifted out round turn. Rdr reported mount was inclined to lay in throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, dropped off in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Near the 300m, when weakening, shifted in.
Bumped with another runner at the start and then shortly after the start was bumped again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Leaders heels 1 Lengths 600m, Hard Ridden on the corner and looked to be battling but he did pick up last 200m and gained minor placing again late # gutsy placing
